reviewer: Codex capability-inventory role, independent of implementation role
scope: Acknowledged editor text and conditional Undo publication
Newer typed/IME draft rebasing while a real save is in flight
Original owner/request checks on success, errors and deferred cleanup
Actual default native reader and unchanged native write/lease authority
Cancellation and bounded test fixture cleanup

findings.finding: A newer return to the original base while B was being saved could remove the pending draft.
findings.resolution: Retain equal-to-base text/IME revisions only while that exact block awaits its native acknowledgement, then use the existing revision rebase.

findings.finding: Later typing cancelled the same debounce task after it had entered the native flush.
findings.resolution: Queue a later save while saving, preserve the active receipt, cancel only a pre-dispatch debounce; unmount and lifetime cancellation remain.

findings.finding: A premount load could keep isLoading true after mount changed epoch, blocking the post-mount load while the old result was discarded.
findings.resolution: Mount retires prior read/loading ownership when it rotates epoch; old defer cannot clear the new owner's spinner.

findings.finding: A write during the initializing load's association await could retire that load before startObservation, without queuing another load.
findings.resolution: A mutation records a pending load before retiring loadingReadID and completes it through the existing deferred-read path.

findings.finding: Load and claims-observer derived-property reads could finish out of order.
findings.resolution: An independent nativePropertiesReadID gates both success and error while preserving editor-request and lifetime checks.

findings.finding: A later explicit held-load phase could race a valid deferred load scheduled by the prior mutation.
findings.resolution: The test observes and awaits the actual internal read-only deferred task with a cancellable deadline before arming the next hold.

reviewedProperties.nativeReadDefault: editorReadOperation delegates to documents.read with the original native lease; no document capture
reviewedProperties.nativeWrites: Original concrete document/block creators, native conditional writes and lease/authorization paths remain in use
reviewedProperties.undo: Retained only when the exact post-write native editor version still matches the inverse's captured expectedVersion
reviewedProperties.weakOwnership: Deferred UI tasks capture the document weakly; the default read closure captures no document
reviewedProperties.testBoundary: Real AnyLib storage and lease paths; only result delivery is delayed or failed. The mounted surface is synthetic and explicitly does not certify UIKit gestures.
reviewedProperties.testCleanup: Purpose-specific gates are cancellable and bounded; fixture releases holds, cancels/awaits its tasks and drains the actual presentation lifetime.

remaining: Semantic compilation and actual execution of all three hosted Apple tests
Mounted NativeLaunch acceptance remains separately gated
